description: Use this when you need the conversations that contain a keyword, sender, recipient, or subject, instead of each matching message. Read-only; requires auth. Inputs: inbox_id (required; inbox id, username, or email), q (required; every word must match subject, body text, from, or to), limit (optional, default 20, max 50). Returns {object:"list", inbox_id, q, data:[thread]} ordered by the best matching message. An empty q returns HTTP 400 missing_query. An unknown inbox returns inbox_not_found.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…), username, or full email address

q.description: Search words; every word must match subject, body, from, or to

name: cooper_search_threads
title: Search threads
